extension.description: Render Kroki diagrams such as PlantUML and D2, tables of contents, task lists and GitHub-style syntax in the built-in Markdown preview.
command.clearDiagramCache: Clear Diagram Cache and Refresh Preview
config.kroki.enabled: Render diagram code blocks such as `plantuml`, `graphviz` and `d2` with Kroki.
config.kroki.server: Kroki server URL. The default public server receives the source of every diagram you preview; point this at a self-hosted server such as `http://localhost:8000` to keep diagrams on your machine.
config.kroki.timeout: How long to wait for the Kroki server, in milliseconds.
config.kroki.languages: Map extra code block languages to Kroki diagram types, for example `{ "uml": "plantuml" }`. Map a language to an empty string to stop rendering it.
config.toc.minLevel: Smallest heading level included in the table of contents.
config.toc.maxLevel: Largest heading level included in the table of contents.
config.toc.sidebar: Show a collapsible table of contents on the right side of the preview.
config.taskList.enabled: Show `[ ]` and `[x]` at the start of list items as checkboxes.
config.taskList.clickToToggle: Clicking a checkbox in the preview checks or unchecks the task in the Markdown source. The file is changed but not saved.
config.alerts.enabled: Render GitHub alerts such as `> [!NOTE]` and `> [!WARNING]`, plus Obsidian-style callouts with a custom title (`> [!tip] Title`), folding (`> [!faq]-`) and other types such as `info` or `bug`.
config.syntax.mark: Render `==text==` as highlighted text. Not part of GitHub Markdown.
config.syntax.superscript: Render `x^2^` as superscript. Not part of GitHub Markdown.
config.syntax.subscript: Render `H~2~O` as subscript. Not part of GitHub Markdown.
config.syntax.containers: Render VitePress-style containers: `::: tip`, `::: info`, `::: warning`, `::: danger` and `::: details`, each with an optional title. Not part of GitHub Markdown.
config.syntax.definitionLists: Render definition lists: a term on one line, followed by `: definition` lines. Not part of GitHub Markdown.
